title: more-itertools: Bug report (issue #1284) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is more-itertools (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #1284) from a user of this library:

> Looking up a key that doesn't exist in a `more_itertools.bucket` adds it. After `'c' in s` (or `s['c']`) for a key with no items, `list(s)` suddenly lists `'c'`, so `'c' in s` and `'c' in list(s)` disagree. A lookup must not create keys; `list(s)` should only list keys that actually had items.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
